content.short: Blasterswap is a native DEX on Blast L2, utilizing concentrated liquidity and integrated native yield features.
content.description:
Blasterswap is a premier decentralized exchange (DEX) built natively on the Blast Layer 2 network, designed to maximize the ecosystem's unique yield-generating capabilities. As a fork of Uniswap v3, it employs concentrated liquidity to provide high capital efficiency for both traders and liquidity providers. A standout feature of Blasterswap is its seamless integration with Blast's native rebasing yield for ETH and USDB, which is automatically passed through to the platform's participants, ensuring that assets are always earning.

In addition to its advanced trading engine, Blasterswap includes a no-code token builder that allows users to launch their own projects on Blast without writing smart contract code. The platform also features incentive programs like Blaster Points to reward early adopters and active community members. By focusing on low fees, high speed, and maximum yield, Blasterswap is positioning itself as a foundational liquidity hub and project incubator within the rapidly growing Blast ecosystem.
